description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    An introductory course on the history of Arkansas. Lectures, discussions, and applied activities will be central to this course. 

Note: This course is a professional education requirement for Early Childhood and Middle Level Education majors, and may not be counted toward the History degree, the Public History degree, or the Social Studies for teacher licensure degree.  

Note: Students may not take this course after completion of HIST 4153.
    
</section>
